<function name="MoveChildTo" parent="DTree" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Moves given node to the top of <page>DTree</page>s children. (Makes it the topmost mode)

Used as a placeholder function alongside <page>DTree:ExpandTo</page>, <page>DTree:SetExpanded</page> and <page>DTree:ChildExpanded</page>.

The <page>DTree</page> acts a root node and methods with the same name in <page>DTree_Node</page> call to the parent.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="child" type="Panel">The node to move</arg>
		<arg name="pos" type="number"><deprecated></deprecated> Unused, does nothing.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
